game.title: Fallout 4
game.blurb: Open-world post-apocalyptic action RPG set in the Commonwealth around Boston, from Bethesda Game Studios, released 2015-11-09. RAWG average playtime: 38 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement names, since every achievement is hidden.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The Sole Survivor leaves Vault 111 to search the Commonwealth. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Factions
chapters.summary: Quest lines for the Minutemen, the Brotherhood of Steel and the Railroad. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Settlements and Companions
chapters.summary: Achievements whose names point to Sanctuary, settlement communities and travelling with others. Grouped by name only.

chapters.title: Life in the Wasteland
chapters.summary: General feats across the Commonwealth. Steam hides every condition, so this chapter is grouped by name only.

chapters.title: Robots (likely Automatron)
chapters.summary: A block of robot-themed achievements after the base game. Placed by list position.

chapters.title: Workshop Add-ons (likely)
chapters.summary: Small blocks of building and settlement achievements between the story add-ons. Placed by list position.

chapters.title: The Island (likely Far Harbor)
chapters.summary: A block about an island and its fog. Placed by list position.

chapters.title: Nuka-World (likely)
chapters.summary: The last block, about raiders and a sugary theme park. Placed by list position.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 377160)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Fallout_4
Fandom (fallout.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Fallout_4
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a guide at completion stage 1, but it is thin: its Table of Contents lists about 100 quests (main quest, Minutemen, Brotherhood, Railroad, Institute, side quests and the add-ons), and only four quest pages are written ("The First Step", about 2,000 characters; "When Freedom Calls", about 2,600; "Out of Time", about 4,100; "Jewel of the Commonwealth", about 1,400), plus Companions, Controls, a short Walkthrough page and a near-empty Achievements and trophies page. That is too little for a real guide, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. fallout.fandom.com answers the API, with about 240 linked pages, including "Automatron (add-on)", "Far Harbor (add-on)", "Nuka-World (add-on)", "Wasteland Workshop", "Contraptions Workshop" and "Vault-Tec Workshop"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. All 84 Steam achievements are hidden and none has a description, so every placement is by name and schema position. Many story and faction achievements share their names with quests on the StrategyWiki contents page, which grouped them. Achievements 51 to 84 were grouped into add-on chapters by position; the add-on names are inferences from RAWG and Fandom, not stated in the achievement data, and the workshop block mixes what are probably three separate add-ons. The main and faction chapters may spoil quest names, since Steam hides all of them.
